statement: Each payments product must hold a current, unexpired Legal approval.
Only employees holding valid Payments Conduct Training (PCT-101, 12 months) may sell or onboard customers to a payments product.
evidence_required: Training records for everyone who sells or onboards

statement: Customer payment data is processed and stored only within the UK or EEA, including by sub-processors.
evidence_required: Register of suppliers that process customer data and where

statement: The customer complaints procedure is documented and reviewed annually.
Premium customers receive 24x7 support, with at least two agents staffed at all times and a first response within 15 minutes for payment failures.
evidence_required: Staffing and funding that cover the committed hours

statement: The regulator is notified at least five business days before launching a new payments feature.
Any material change to an approved product (new feature, new third-party processor of customer data, new service commitment) requires Legal re-approval before release.
evidence_required: Change control request and re-approval for the release version

statement: Active supplier contracts must not be past their end date.
Each product has a named accountable senior manager who is available to approve actions, respond to regulators and sign off material changes.
evidence_required: Named accountable senior manager and their availability

statement: A data processing agreement must be signed before a supplier processes customer data.
